newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins steady on mixed US data.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins steady on mixed US data.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were steady on Friday, with little reaction to US data, dealers said.

The U.S. Labour Department said May payrolls rose 138,000 against a forecast 219,000, while the April rise was revised up to 323,000 from 142,000. Average earnings firmed 0.3 percent versus a forecast 0.4 percent rise, and the jobless rate was at a 23-year low of 4.8 percent.
"The market is firm, there were almost no fluctuations," Most Bank dealer Alexander Rodionov said. "The U.S. figures had no visible impact after all."
MinFins, along with other emerging debt, are sensitive to any news which would suggest a change in U.S. interest rates and consequently affect U.S. Treasury bond prices.
"There were some fluctuations but prices are sticking to early levels," one dealer said. "They edged up after the figures but selling started afterwards."
